transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. I guess I came in because... well, I just barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself anymore. 

Things like dance class, hiking, trying out new recipes... even game night. They all just sit there now like chores I keep putting off. I just don't really have the interest to do any of it.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

No, this is the first time. I've never really felt like this before. It's basically been going on since the robbery at that festival job I was working at. That was about... two years and three months ago, I think.
Since that robbery occurred, do you find yourself having unwanted, vivid memories or nightmares about the event?

Yeah, I do. It's mostly during the day. Sometimes just hearing a cash box snap shut, or... if somebody comes up behind me in a kitchen, it brings the whole robbery back so fast. It's like I can actually hear the voices again, and my stomach just drops, like it is happening right then.
Do you go out of your way to avoid places, people, or activities that remind you of the robbery?

Yeah, I do. I just... I go out of my way to turn down any festival jobs now. And evening deliveries, or even certain shared kitchens. I just avoid them because I really don't want to think about that night, or feel that panic start up all over again.
